verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents a public API reference that covers anything you can do in the UI (integrations, incidents, webhooks). The API uses token-based API key authentication and supports bot tokens for non-user automation. An OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec is published via the official MCP repo against api.firehydrant.io. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec at standard docs paths (probe 404s) and no independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
